collection.description: A Nox Orchid is said to bloom near the grieving, but a scientist sees it follows rain.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A Nox Orchid is said to bloom near people who are grieving. A scientist notices that its flowering follows rain.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: A family finds comfort without claiming proof of magic.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The correlation grows clearer but does not explain every story.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The elder says meanings need not be proven facts.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: The orchid flowers again, and nobody agrees why this particular day feels important.
